[P1] Snapshot branch membership before publishing skips

`getBranches()` returns a `Collections.synchronizedList`, whose iterator is not protected by its synchronized mutators. Early completion permits the context thread to keep registering branches while this checkpoint callback runs. An append between iterator creation and a subsequent `next()` can throw `ConcurrentModificationException`, interrupting checkpoint response processing and leaving skip publication incomplete. Iterate a stable snapshot and coordinate concurrent registrations through the same membership/publication protocol.
